ref.note: Accounting item: these are employer social-contribution reductions that ESA 2010 books as spending. Cutting the line means the reductions shrink, so employers pay more social contributions; adding means they pay less. No service is cut. 'Plus-plannen' in Tabel II.3 is the first-hire reduction: the Court of Audit (doc-56-1469-002 p. 48) gives the same amount, 512,5 M EUR, as 'bijdrageverminderingen voor eerste aanwervingen'. The paid-athletes reduction is described in the same report (p. 49, footnote 51). The regionalised reductions (footnote 5, e.g. older workers, subsidised contract staff; financed by the federated entities) are also in this line but are set and paid for by the regions, so no phrase is built on them. The horeca reduction is abolished from 1 July 2026 (footnote 4). corrected: phrases now say plainly that a cut means higher (an increase lower) employer contributions, instead of 'smaller/larger social-contribution cuts'; first-hire claim confirmed by the Court of Audit (doc-56-1469-002 p. 48, 512,5 M EUR = 'Plus-plannen'); 'older workers' dropped because that reduction is regional (footnote 5), replaced by the federal paid-athletes reduction
